text:
morgan: quick sync — proposal for the rollout pattern for GreenWave feature (model routing + cheaper quantized variant). thinking staged regions + small A/B probes then widen. want buy-in on telemetry gates and fallback ordering

tanya: SGTM. can we keep initial probe to <1% global traffic? also need explicit metrics to gate on — latency, p90, model-error-rate, and regressions on quality tests

ryan: +1. suggest probes per-region (us-west, eu-central) to catch infra/regional differences. probe sizes: 0.5% per-region for 24h, then 2% for 12h, then 10% for 6h before global ramp

morgan: sounds good. proposed gating thresholds: 
```
- p90 latency increase <= 15ms
- 5xx spike <= +0.2% absolute
- quality regression (eval set) A/B lift >= -0.5% absolute
- token-cost delta capped at +8%
```
these are soft thresholds for initial probe, stricter for wider ramp

sam: can we automate rollback? ops-bot + feature flag kill switch? also owner for fast follow: @ryan on infra, @tanya on quality signals

ops-bot: scheduled deploy detected for GreenWave v1.2 to us-west eu-central at 2026-05-04T15:00Z. Reminder: add runbook link and emergency flag name to the deploy description

ryan: automation plan: feature flag name `gw_model_routing_v1` with rollout policy steps 0.5 -> 2 -> 10 -> 30 -> 100. implement auto-decrease if any gate breaches for 2 consecutive evaluation windows (5m windows)

morgan: fallback ordering: 1) quantized variant fallback (cheaper model), 2) pin to previous stable model, 3) route to Dedicated fallback pool. explicit priority in routing rules needed

tanya: telemetry -> we'll publish a lightweight dashboard (per-region) with these signals and a synthetic prompt set for quality diffs. need owners for alerts: latency -> infra oncall, quality regressions -> research/qa pager

sam: A/B config: use cookie/tenant split depending on target. For big tenants we'll do tenant opt-in cohorts first. small tenants/randomize for global probe. document in rollout checklist: tenant-exclusion whitelist, legal/data residency flags

morgan: rollout checklist items:
- add runbook link to deploy description
- add `gw_model_routing_v1` flag with staged weights
- synthetic eval harness and signal thresholds in telemetry
- set autoscale buffer for Dedicated fallback pool + circuit breaker
- communication plan: email to customers with beta opt-in + postmortem owner

ryan: add-on: throttling policy if token-cost delta > +12% for >1h -> pause new signups into variant and notify bizops

tanya: regression test to include edge-case prompts we saw last month (long-context math prompts). will attach patch to eval suite PR by EOD

morgan: final decision: proceed with staged regional probes. owners: morgan (product coord), ryan (infra + routing), tanya (quality), sam (customer ops). I'll open the feature-flag PR and attach the runbook link. tagging follow-ups in GH issues

sam: I'll draft the customer note and tenant opt-in flow, send for review by EOD :+1:

ops-bot: deploy window locked until runbook link present. Use `/deploy unlock` after runbook added.
